messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000619": feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, and most of them were identical.  (about: feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000615" [decision]: As of 2025-09-02, clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: feature-flags, clients)
- memory_id "1000362": feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: feature-flags, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1000180": The job scheduler depends on feature-flags for per-job kill switches.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000043": feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000682": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000526" [decision]: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000454": On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the billing API handover document for Lena.  (about: Lena, billing API, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000296" [constraint]: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000195" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000087": The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings.  (about: ledger service, billing API)
- memory_id "1000567": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team pager instead of Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000561" [decision]: As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000555": As of 2025-07-30, the Atlas team consists of Priya Raman, after Tomasz left the team.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000551": Tomasz left the Atlas team and joined team Dune on 2025-07-30.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz, team Dune)
- memory_id "1000416" [constraint]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, indexer)
- memory_id "1000033": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000687": Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000599" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000430": INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000610" [constraint]: The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000438" [decision]: Ledger service migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000575": INC-2025-017 was an incident where the auth gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000248": The ledger service depends on the auth gateway for service tokens.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
Existing entity names: feature-flags, clients, Tuesday's deploy, job scheduler, Atlas team, ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service, Lena, Oskar, Priya Raman, Tomasz, team Dune, indexer, INC-2025-011, auth gateway, INC-2025-017

The note:

[2025-09-30] standup/atlas/2025-09-30: Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. The billing API now depends on the feature flag service. The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.

New facts:
1. Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. — entities: billing API, feature-flags, new invoice flow. The note says "billing-api" and "feature flag service" as names — these are aliases for existing entities "billing API" and "feature-flags".
2. The billing API now depends on the feature flag service. — This is a relation: billing API depends_on feature-flags.
3. The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday. — fact about Atlas team.

Aliases:
- "billing-api" → "billing API"
- "feature flag service" → "feature-flags"

Relations:
- add_relations: src "billing API", dst "feature-flags", rel_kind "depends_on", evidence "The billing API now depends on the feature flag service."

Should I add the fact "The billing API now depends on the feature flag service" as a fact too? Relations capture the dependency. The note states it explicitly; adding a fact plus relation might be duplicative. The instruction says a relation joins two entities; the dependency is best captured as a relation. I could also add the decision fact about gating the invoice flow.

Facts to add:
1. [decision] "The billing API gates the new invoice flow behind feature-flags because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch." entities: billing API, feature-flags, new invoice flow. Evidence: "billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch"
2. "The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday." entities: Atlas team. Evidence: "The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday."

Should the dependency be a fact as well? It's captured as a relation; the guideline says add one relation for each relationship the note states. The fact "The billing API now depends on the feature flag service" is redundant with the relation. I'll just include the relation. Actually, some practices include both, but to avoid duplication, relation suffices.

Aliases:
- billing-api → billing API, evidence: "billing-api will gate the new invoice flow"
- feature flag service → feature-flags, evidence: "The billing API now depends on the feature flag service."

Confidence: 1.0 for facts.

Note: "new invoice flow" — is it an entity? It's a thing mentioned. Include it as an entity.

Output JSON only.
